verdicts.quote: “We offer the following API authentication mechanisms to access Freshdesk resources: … OAuth authorization and access token authentication.”
verdicts.reason: Freshworks’ own docs for Freshdesk apps explicitly list OAuth as a supported auth method for accessing Freshdesk data; endpoints in the API reference also define OAuth 2.0 scopes, so OAuth2 is the primary choice for a multi-tenant integration.

verdicts.quote: “After you submit an app for review, the app details sidebar displays: • Overall status tag: For example, Under Review, Ready to publish, or Changes requested.”
verdicts.reason: Public, cross‑tenant apps in the Freshworks Marketplace go through a platform review before production use; while API keys are self‑serve, production OAuth apps require this review, matching app_review.

verdicts.quote: “Freshdesk offers objects that are native to a helpdesk system, like tickets, contacts, and companies… With ‘Custom Objects’… you can perform create, read, update, and delete operations on the Custom Object records.”
verdicts.reason: The API spans many resource categories (tickets, contacts, companies, discussions/forums, solutions/KB, SLAs, business hours, products, email configs, agents/roles, custom objects, etc.) with CRUD, which qualifies as broad.

verdicts.quote: “The Freshworks Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI tools like Cursor and Claude to securely connect and interact with Freshdesk.”
verdicts.reason: This is an official Freshdesk Support article describing the vendor‑hosted MCP server (including the endpoint format https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp), so the MCP is official.

verdicts.quote: “The number of API calls per minute is based on your plan… For all trial users, there is a default API limit of 50 calls/minute.”
verdicts.reason: Composio can ship now: API keys are self‑serve and the REST API is well‑documented. Caveats: plan‑based rate limits and, for cross‑tenant OAuth distribution, Marketplace app review; additionally, the official MCP currently authenticates via API key only.
